question: Which Article specifies the Fundamental Duties of every citizen?
solution:
• **Article 51A specifies the Fundamental Duties of every Indian citizen**
 
• The fundamental duties are a list of directives stated in the Constitution which must be followed by every citizen of the nation
 
• There are 11 Fundamental Duties as listed below
 
 
• To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the national Flag and the National Anthem
 
• To cherish and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom
